readings: Positions are 1-indexed (standard LFSR notation): taps at q[31], q[21], q[1], q[0] (mask 0x80200003).
Positions are 0-indexed: position 32 is invalid, so map 32 to q[31] and use q[22], q[2], q[1] (mask 0x80400006).

ambiguities.aspect: Order of XOR and shift in Galois update
readings: Standard: next_q[i] = q[i+1] XOR (q[0] & tap[i]) for i<31, next_q[31] = q[0] & tap[31].
Alternative: XOR is applied to the current bit at the tapped position before shifting, so next_q[i] = q[i+1] XOR (q[0] & tap[i+1]) (tap mask effectively shifted by one).
q is initialized to 32'h1 at power-up even if reset is never asserted.
q is undefined until reset is asserted; only reset defines the initial state.
